name: Input language
author: ViberDock
description: The keyboard language indicator the taskbar had: the current input language's short code (ENG, DEU, FRA …), with its region under it when needed, optionally the language's full name. A click switches to the next layout (as Windows + Space does); the popup lists every installed layout, a click on one selects it.

settings.label: Region under the code
settings.description: Writes the region (US, GB, DE …) under the language code, as the taskbar does. Automatic: only when two installed layouts have the same language code (English US and English UK). Default: automatic.

settings.label: Show the language's full name
settings.description: Writes the language's name (English (United States)) beside the code, under it on a side dock. Off by default.

settings.label: Size
settings.description: How big the text is: 1 is the usual size, 2 twice as big. Default: 1.

settings.label: Font
settings.description: A font family installed on this PC. Empty: Segoe UI.

settings.label: Code colour
settings.description: The language code's colour. Transparent (#00000000): the theme's text colour.

settings.label: Region and name colour
settings.description: The region's and the full name's colour. Transparent (#00000000): the theme's date colour.

settings.label: A click
settings.description: What a click on the widget does: switch to the next layout (as Windows + Space does; Windows shows its switcher for a moment), or open the list of layouts. Default: the next layout.

settings.label: A middle click
settings.description: What a middle click does. Default: opens the list of layouts.

settings.label: Take no room while only one layout is installed
settings.description: With a single keyboard layout there is nothing to switch: the widget can take no room on the dock then. Off: it shows the code anyway.
